nodes.label: Guinea1998 model
nodes.rationale: Ecobase 646; 44 source groups plus diet_import; separate from Guinea1985 Ecobase 726.

nodes.label: Guenette and Diallo 2004 Guinea coastal models addendum
nodes.norm_label: guenette and diallo 2004 guinea coastal models addendum

nodes.label: Guinea1998 geographic transfer
nodes.rationale: The model covers 111,932 km2 off the country Guinea, beyond its EEZ; 43% is shallower than 200 m. It is not a demonstrated model of the full Guinea Current LME. The LME_028 transfer remains unvalidated until overlap and representativeness are established.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 ecological group axes
nodes.rationale: L/G means large, M medium, S/P small, inv invertebrate feeders and pred piscivorous/cephalopod predators. Coastal groups occur chiefly below 40 m, demersal groups at 20-200 m and bathyal groups beyond 200 m. These ecological assemblages do not require every taxon to be split geographically.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 Table 6 membership precedence
nodes.rationale: Full Table 6 yields 263 fish-member rows plus the explicit Cephalopoda definition. Printed names are retained with expanded initials and archived WoRMS crosswalks. Table 7 diet-study examples from other regions cannot establish membership; Table 14 historical fishery allocation cannot replace biological membership.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 Mulets and Dem M inv membership
nodes.rationale: Mulets contains non-mullets; Mugil curema is explicitly in Dem M inv and must not be moved to Mulets using its common name. Major tunas also include source billfish. Cross-model interpretation: The same common-name mullet intuition yields incompatible model-specific membership and unmatched-guild risk.
nodes.norm_label: guinea1998 mulets and dem m inv membership

nodes.label: Guinea1998 Solitas gruveli dual membership
nodes.rationale: Solitas gruveli is explicitly printed in both Dem L pred and Dem S pred; the unresolved source ambiguity is preserved.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 numerical provenance differences
nodes.rationale: Thirteen B/EE entries differ beyond strict printed rounding, mostly EE by less than 0.002 and B by less than 0.001; PB/QB match. Oiseaux source TL is 3.77 versus imported 3.545. Source diets and catch/discard reconstruction are approximate. Parameters were not silently corrected; input balance does not prove source fidelity.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 source-only deterministic ablation
nodes.rationale: Historical note describes a newly built isolated source-only baseline from untouched catch stub and Table6 exact/accepted names and genus unions. It is a bounded deterministic ablation, not a blinded independent-agent experiment, not a comparison of complete skills, and not evidence of accuracy gains from combining skills. Its earlier absence-of-A/B statement is historical, not a claim about later repository state.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 source-only ablation outcome
nodes.rationale: Source-only coverage is 52.2%, and group-set agreement is 53.6% of tonnage. The principal difference is the 32.3% unidentified marine fish catch apportioned across coastal/shelf residual guilds. This does not compare PPR methods or validate time/space applicability. composite_split accounting differs from member-validator coverage.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 mapping coverage
nodes.rationale: 375 rows and 43 composites; 165,272,510.790 of 167,652,883.904 tonnes mapped over 1950-2019, or 98.5802%. Catch confidence is high 41.487%, medium 23.634%, low 33.459%, unresolved 1.420%. Confidence remains conditional on model applicability.

nodes.label: Guinea1998 unresolved guild and habitat matches
nodes.rationale: Freshwater/brackish Sarotherodon catch lacks a documented source compartment. Unlisted Pentheroscion, Gobiidae, Mugil cephalus and others cannot be placed by family or habitat alone when feeding/depth guilds are ambiguous. Table 7 analogues are insufficient membership evidence.
nodes.norm_label: guinea1998 unresolved guild and habitat matches

nodes.label: Guinea1998 deterministic regeneration and Monte Carlo retry
nodes.rationale: Only taxonomy metadata changed. Deterministic SPPR values and missingness reproduce to 1e-9. The first MC_new_GE 180-second timeout was a runtime limitation, not biology. A 600-second retry completed in 449.60 seconds; all 20 methods succeeded, with 45 finite cells per scope and no lost finite values.
nodes.norm_label: guinea1998 deterministic regeneration and monte carlo retry
